BUSINESS GOAL: Create a digital storefront capable of supporting a target of 1,000 sales per month at $9 per sale, equal to $9,000 gross monthly revenue. Do not promise guaranteed income. STEP 1 — HOMEPAGE: Create a modern, high-converting homepage with a compelling headline, product benefits, clear call-to-action, product preview, FAQ, and testimonials section for verified reviews only. STEP 2 — DIGITAL PRODUCT: Create a product listing for a $9 downloadable PDF called The Digital Product Starter Kit. Include a clear product description, sample pages, benefits, and instant access after purchase. STEP 3 — CHECKOUT: Integrate a supported secure payment provider using verified checkout and webhook events. Do not mark orders paid without payment confirmation. Support mobile checkout and receipts. STEP 4 — AUTOMATED DELIVERY: After confirmed payment, create a customer account or secure access link, deliver the digital download, and send an order confirmation email. Protect paid files from public access. STEP 5 — EMAIL CAPTURE: Create a free beginner checklist lead magnet, opt-in form, consent controls, and an email welcome sequence using a supported integration. STEP 6 — CUSTOMER DASHBOARD: Allow customers to sign in, view purchases, access downloads, and contact support. STEP 7 — ADMIN DASHBOARD: Build a private admin panel displaying verified orders, gross revenue, refunds, net revenue after recorded fees, conversion rate, and progress toward 1,000 monthly sales. STEP 8 — MARKETING: Add shareable product links, SEO metadata, TikTok and Instagram CTA sections, and optional analytics integration. Do not invent sales or testimonials. STEP 9 — TRUST AND LEGAL: Add privacy policy, terms, refund policy, contact page, and clear disclaimers. Allow the owner to edit all policies. STEP 10 — TESTING: Test checkout, payment confirmation, protected download access, mobile responsiveness, email delivery, and admin permissions before publishing. Use a clean, premium visual design, with blue, white, and black colors. Make all text, prices, products, and images editable from the admin dashboard. Clearly identify integrations that require manual setup. Prioritize a working MVP over placeholder functionality.

What exactly IS a digital product? Let me break down every type — with examples. If you've been seeing people talk about 'selling digital products' and wondering what they're actually selling — this is for you. A digital product is anything you create once and sell repeatedly — delivered instantly online, no shipping, no inventory, no returns. Here are the main types: 📄 EBOOKS & GUIDES — PDFs that teach something specific. 'Beginner's Guide to Instagram,' '30-Day Content Plan,' 'How to Start Affiliate Marketing.' Sell for $7–$47. Create in Canva for free. 🎨 TEMPLATES — Pre-made designs buyers customize. Instagram templates, planners, resumes, business cards. Sell for $9–$97. Create in Canva. 🎓 COURSES & WORKSHOPS — Video or written lessons teaching a skill. Can sell for $47–$997+. Host on Stan Store or Beacons. 📦 DONE-FOR-YOU PRODUCTS (PLR/MRR) — Products already created that you can resell. Perfect for beginners who aren't ready to create from scratch yet. 📋 PLANNERS, WORKBOOKS & PRINTABLES — Fillable or printable pages. Budget planners, habit trackers, goal workbooks. Sell for $5–$37. These get the most saves and shares on social. The best part? You don't have to create anything to start. You can begin with a done-for-you product while you're still learning — then create your own once you understand what your audience actually wants. Save this. Share it with someone who's been confused about what this is.
